# What is Paddle?

Paddle is the developer-first merchant of record, built for modern SaaS, mobile app, AI, and digital product companies. It helps you increase your revenue, decrease your costs, and reduce your risk.

Paddle is an all-in-one payments and billing [merchant of record](https://mor.paddle.com/) for modern SaaS, mobile app, AI, and digital product companies.

You can use Paddle to add checkout, subscriptions, global tax compliance, metrics, fraud protection, and retention tooling to your app through one unified API.

Thousands of software businesses run on Paddle, including [n8n](https://www.paddle.com/customers/how-paddle-helped-n8n-io-grow-mrr), [Runna](https://www.paddle.com/customers/how-mobile-app-runna-monetized-on-the-web), [Nexus Mods](https://www.paddle.com/customers/helping-nexus-mods-unlock-the-gaming-community), [Relay.app](https://www.paddle.com/customers/relayapp-live-in-weeks-sells-globally-without-barriers), and [CrashPlan](https://www.paddle.com/customers/crashplan-doubled-sign-ups-with-paddle). [Lovable Payments](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/ai/lovable) is powered by Paddle, so builders on Lovable can monetize their apps in minutes.

Across our customer base, moving to Paddle typically delivers:

~25%

Higher payment acceptance

Global payment methods, smart routing, and fraud protection come as standard.

~20%

Improved net revenue retention

Compliant workflows and automated payment recovery help you retain more revenue.

~35%

Lower cost of revenue delivery

One single integration and full tax and regulatory compliance reduces your costs.

## What you get with one integration [Copy link to this section](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/how-paddle-works/\#what-you-get-with-one-integration)

Payments is never just payments. Building a billing stack is a complex engineering effort that requires a lot of time and attention. It typically involves stitching together a bunch of systems and services, each with their own APIs and conventions.

With Paddle, it's one integration:

- **Global payments in minutes.**

Accept payments in [30+ currencies](https://developer.paddle.com/concepts/sell/supported-currencies) across [200 markets](https://developer.paddle.com/concepts/sell/supported-countries-locales), with one-click access to digital wallets and payment methods, routed across multiple acquirers.
- **Modern subscription billing engine.**

Offer any billing model, and handle all of the subscription lifecycle with [proration](https://developer.paddle.com/concepts/subscriptions/proration), [trials](https://developer.paddle.com/concepts/subscriptions/trials), [pauses](https://developer.paddle.com/build/subscriptions/pause-subscriptions), [upgrades](https://developer.paddle.com/build/subscriptions/replace-products-prices-upgrade-downgrade), [one-time charges](https://developer.paddle.com/build/subscriptions/bill-add-one-time-charge), [invoicing](https://developer.paddle.com/concepts/sell/sales-assisted-invoice), and [credit notes](https://developer.paddle.com/build/transactions/create-transaction-adjustments/).
- **Worldwide sales tax - handled.**

Paddle calculates, collects, and remits taxes for you across the world. No need to register for VAT, GST, or sales tax in the countries where you operate.
- **Enter new markets without the complexity.**

Grow your sales volume by [pricing for countries](https://developer.paddle.com/build/products/offer-localized-pricing), offering localized payment methods, and automatically presenting prices in a way customers expect.
- **Compliance as regulations change.**

Paddle handles payment, subscription, and invoicing compliance as legislation changes, so you don't have to. Paddle is fully compliant with regulations across the globe.
- **Automated payment recovery.**

Let [Paddle Retain](https://developer.paddle.com/concepts/retain) automatically recover failed payments for you, with a recovery rate of over 50%.
- **Fraud, chargebacks, and billing support.**

Paddle screens transactions, fights chargebacks, and handles customer billing support for you, so you can focus on growing your business.

## The merchant of record model [Copy link to this section](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/how-paddle-works/\#the-merchant-of-record-model)

A [merchant of record (MoR)](https://mor.paddle.com/) is a legal entity responsible for selling goods or services to an end customer. Your MoR manages payments and takes on the associated liabilities, such as collecting sales tax, ensuring PCI compliance, and honoring refunds and chargebacks.

![A diagram showing the merchant of record model, with Paddle as the MoR and the customer as the seller.](https://developer.paddle.com/_astro/mor.CY9yKtMf.png)![A diagram showing the merchant of record model, with Paddle as the MoR and the customer as the seller.](https://developer.paddle.com/_astro/mor-dark.C7-pnhRk.png)

From your perspective:

- You don't register for VAT, GST, or sales tax in the countries where you operate.
- You don't carry chargeback or PCI scope.
- You don't operate a customer support function for billing issues.
- You don't need local entities to accept local payment methods.

From a customer's perspective:

- Customers go through a modern checkout experience, with Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, cards, and local payment methods.
- Checkout appears branded or fully embedded as part of your app or website.
- Paddle handles the transaction, including collecting sales tax and handling refunds and chargebacks.
- Your name appears on the customer's statement alongside Paddle's.

## Built for developers and AI builders [Copy link to this section](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/how-paddle-works/\#built-for-developers-and-ai-builders)

Paddle is built for developers and AI builders. We ship the developer surfaces you'd expect from a modern platform:

[A single REST API\\
\\
Resource-oriented, versioned, with structured errors.](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference) [Webhooks\\
\\
A rich event stream with a built-in simulator for local development.](https://developer.paddle.com/webhooks) [SDKs\\
\\
Official libraries for Node.js, PHP, Python, and Go for your backend.](https://developer.paddle.com/sdks/libraries) [Paddle.js\\
\\
A modern JavaScript library for building checkout experiences in your frontend.](https://developer.paddle.com/paddle-js) [MCP and AI tooling\\
\\
MCP servers for agents, docs that plug in your IDE, and skills to integrate fast.](https://developer.paddle.com/sdks/ai) [Starter kits\\

Complete demo apps so you can build on a solid foundation, or rework for your app.](https://developer.paddle.com/sdks/starter-kits)

[Paddle is the merchant of record powering Lovable Payments, so you can take an app from prompt to payment in minutes.](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/ai/lovable)

## Multiple paths to integration [Copy link to this section](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/how-paddle-works/\#multiple-paths-to-integration)

You don't have to build a custom checkout to start selling. Most teams pick one of these and mix as needed:

Hosted checkout

Fastest path for mobile apps. Configure in the dashboard, add to your app.

Overlay checkout

Open a modern checkout in a few lines of code.

Inline checkout

Embed a checkout directly in your app or website, with full control over layout.

Starter kits

Everything you need to build an app from signup to subscription management.

Customer portal

Drop in a self-service portal for customers to manage their subscriptions.

SDKs

Build fully integrated subscription management.
